field.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
field.help: How often to poll switches (60-86400 seconds). Default: 300.

field.label: Enable LLDP Discovery
field.help: Use LLDP to automatically discover neighboring switches.

field.label: Auto-Add Discovered Switches
field.help: Automatically add switches discovered via LLDP to the inventory.

field.label: LLDP Interfaces
field.help: Select interface(s) to monitor for LLDP neighbors. Leave empty to use all interfaces.

field.label: Offline Threshold (seconds)
field.help: Mark a switch as offline after this many seconds without a response. Default: 900.
